## Conditional Rendering React doesn't have special directives like `v-if`. Instead, you use plain JavaScript: ### Patterns ```jsx // Ternary {isLoggedIn ? : } // && short-circuit (render or nothing) {showBanner && } // Early return if (isLoading) return ; ``` ### Your Task Build a login/logout toggle: 1. Track `isLoggedIn` state, starting as **false** 2. When logged out: - Show `

` with text **"Please log in"** - Show a button with id `"login-btn"` and text **"Log In"** 3. When logged in: - Show `

` with text **"Welcome back!"** - Show a button with id `"logout-btn"` and text **"Log Out"** 4. Add a `` that only appears when logged in, containing **"Online"**
